top_signals.title: Russia is running out of cash due to its war in Ukraine: report
top_signals.summary: Russia’s war spending pushed the state to the brink of running out of cash this spring, according to a Bloomberg report, as Russian leaders double down.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Chile Bond Investors Test Riskier Debt on Growth Revival Bets
top_signals.summary: Chilean investors are dipping a toe into lower-rated corporate bonds on bets that the new administration’s economic reform will revive growth.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Technicians Cautious Ahead of S&P 500’s Worst Month Historically
top_signals.summary: The outlook for earnings growth for the S&P 500 Index is bright following a blockbuster reporting season and multiple Wall Street strategists have raised their year-end targets for the benchmark. As the kids say nowadays: The vibes are immaculate.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: ChatGPT faces tougher rules under EU online safety regime
top_signals.summary: Reddit and Roblox also designated as very large online platforms under the bloc’s Digital Services Act
